findings.evidence:
NEW ROUND-3 FINDING at HEAD efd9896a0. Three states emit a POST /api/frontend/pricing/preview that returns 401 (Unauthorized) WITHOUT any role="alert" / .toast / .alert-* rendered in the DOM, satisfying REVIEWER_PROTOCOL category 6 (silent_error → P0). Exact artifacts:
  • 311-01-step-sauce.network.json: [{status:401, method:POST, url:http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/frontend/pricing/preview, ts:1778443343867}]
  • 311-02-step-supplements.network.json: [{status:401, ..., ts:1778443345191}]
  • 314-02-step-supplements.network.json: [{status:401, ..., ts:1778443350787}]
Matching console.json entries surface 'Failed to load resource: the server responded with a status of 401 (Unauthorized)' in each of the 3 states (NOT pusher/ws noise — application fetch). DOM verification on 311-01-step-sauce.dom.html: grep 'role="alert"' = 0, only 2 occurrences of role="status" (kiosk-toast-container aria-live="polite" + a screen-reader-only status node), both empty.

Allowlist check (REVIEWER_PROTOCOL §Allowlist): the protocol allowlists 401 ONLY for /api/auth/logout. /api/frontend/pricing/preview is NOT allowlisted.

ROOT CAUSE: the C-001 fix in commit efd9896a0 removed the mount-time refreshServerPreviewTotal() $nextTick call, but the deep `selections` watcher still fires preview on every user mutation. When the user navigates to a *subsequent* wizard mount (cat 311 / cat 314 after the cat 309 / cat 310 wizards already executed), the deep watcher fires again BEFORE the Sanctum bearer is re-bound in the helper's interceptor read path, reproducing the original cold-start race window — now at interaction-time rather than mount-time. The retry interceptor (app.js L107) silently replays and succeeds → totals integrity preserved (12,50/13,50/8,50/6,00 = 40,50€) → but the toast helper onError NEVER fires → no role=alert renders → category 6 silent_error open.

SCOPE CONFIRMATION: commit efd9896a0 verification block reads 'npx playwright test wave-C → 1 passed'. Wave B was NOT re-executed before declaring C-001 closed — the team's Wave-C-only re-test missed the Wave B regression.
findings.fix_hint:
Two options, pick one or both (belt + suspenders):
(A) Gate the deep `selections` watcher's refreshServerPreviewTotal call on token-bound state. In resources/js/components/frontend/kiosk/KioskWizardComponent.vue around the watch('selections', { deep:true, handler: ... }) block (after L1945 area where buildInstruction lives), add a guard: skip refreshServerPreviewTotal() until store.getters['kioskAuth/hasToken'] (or equivalent) is true, and re-fire one-shot when the token binds.
(B) Wire the helper's onError callback to fire regardless of retry success. In resources/js/helpers/pricing-preview.js (or wherever refreshServerPreviewTotal is defined; see L28-L30 graceful-degradation path referenced in commit efd9896a0), emit a warning toast on the FIRST 401 before retry — current code only emits onError after final failure, which never happens because the retry succeeds. Either path makes the silent_error visible (role=alert) and closes B-008.
Option A is cleaner (kills root cause). Option B is the audit-hygiene belt — recommended even if A is shipped, so any future cold-start race that fails terminally still surfaces.
CRITICAL: re-run wave-B (not just wave-C) after the fix.
